## About ERGO HealthTech

ERGO HealthTech Ltd. is a Hong Kong-based health technology company headquartered at HKSTP (Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks), Sha Tin, Hong Kong.

We are an all-rounded expert in human health protection, specialising in:
- 222nm Far-UVC germicidal solutions for occupied indoor spaces
- Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) monitoring and management
- Portable and spatial disinfection technology
- Chemical disinfection (ecodis, Germany's No. 1 certified active chlorine disinfectant)

Our technology is validated by Columbia University, The University of Hong Kong (HKU), HKUST, City University of Hong Kong (CityU), and endorsed in a WHO webinar (December 2021).

Description: Company overview, product range, solutions by sector, and UNVEIL science section.

### UNVEIL — Science Hub
URL: https://www.ergo-healthtech.com/unveil/
Description: The world's first dual-version public science statement on 222nm Far-UVC technology. Two pages: a full science statement and a 19-question FAQ.

### The Science Behind 222nm Far-UVC Defense
URL: https://www.ergo-healthtech.com/unveil/science
Description: Peer-reviewed science statement on viruses, vaccines, and 222nm Far-UVC. Available in plain English ("Unveil the Science") and academic ("Academic & Clinical") versions. Covers viral replication biology, vaccine efficacy data (2025-2026 CDC and HK CHP data), 222nm photolysis mechanisms, Defective Interfering Particle (DIP) equivalence theory, and a three-layer synergistic defense matrix.
Key claims:
- 1.7 mJ/cm² achieves 99.9% inactivation of aerosolized coronaviruses (Buonanno et al., 2020)
- 2 mJ/cm² inactivates >95% of airborne H1N1 influenza (Welch et al., 2018)
- 99.8% airborne viral load reduction in occupied rooms (Scientific Reports, 2024)
- ACGIH safe exposure limits: 479 mJ/cm² skin, 161 mJ/cm² eyes (8-hour daily)
- 222nm Far-UVC converts active virions into artificial Defective Interfering Particles (DIPs)

### Airborne Viruses & 222nm Far-UVC: Your Questions Answered
URL: https://www.ergo-healthtech.com/unveil/faq
Description: 19 expert questions answered across 6 topics: virus biology, vaccine passive immunity, uncovered populations, 222nm Far-UVC mechanism, the three-layer defense strategy, and the bigger picture. Accordion format with key points visible and full answers expandable.

## Key Scientific References

1. Buonanno, M. et al. (2020). Far-UVC light (222 nm) efficiently and safely inactivates airborne human coronaviruses. Scientific Reports, 10, 10285. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-020-67211-2

2. Welch, D. et al. (2018). Far-UVC light: A new tool to control the spread of airborne-mediated microbial diseases. Scientific Reports, 8, 2752. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-018-21058-w

3. 222 nm far-UVC light markedly reduces the level of infectious airborne virus in an occupied room. Scientific Reports (2024). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-59886-4

4. Corneal safety assessment of germicidal far UV-C radiation. Scientific Reports (2025). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-025-87318-y

5. Angel, D.M. et al. (2025). The Susceptibility of Airborne SARS-CoV-2 to Far-UVC Irradiation. Environmental Science & Technology. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40970481/

6. Zhang et al. (2025). 222nm UV disinfection effectiveness and safety. Chinese Journal of Disinfection, 42(6), 401-404. https://manu63.magtech.com.cn/zgxdx/CN/10.11726/j.issn.1001-7658.2025.06.001
